defects.detail: 'does not at all adorn the one who praises' for 'οὐχ ἧττον ἐπικοσμεῖ' (no less adorns the praiser than the praised)
'For to save a man who is being punished—like pushing a fire' over garbled Phoebidas/Cadmea and Sphodrias sentences; both men and the acquittal lost
'Through ignorance of his friends' ambitions, he himself became the weakest' makes Solon the subject; reference has Agesilaus (OCR 'ἀγνοίας δὲ πόλε')
'Nicias, if he does not act unjustly, he is not unjust' for 'νικίαν, εἰ μὲν οὐκ ἀδικεῖ ἀφρὸς' (acquit him in every case)
'one should also contribute non-friendship; for one should not command' for 'τὰς ἀφίλας συνεισφέρειν' (associate friends in favours, bid the benefited thank them)
'arriving to Menexenus, to whom Pelopidas had left a guard' — Epaminondas refusing Pelopidas' request for the victualler is lost
'by refusing the need quickly with anger, one removes the heaviness' for 'τῷ γὰρ ὀργῷ τὴν χρείαν ... ἀπειπάμενον, ἀφελεῖν τοῦ λόγου' (he could have refused in deed without harsh words)
'most men admire their friends who are superior to money' — Xenophon on Agesilaus enriching friends while himself above money
'The challenge pleased the army ... more warlike for him to be a woman' for 'ἤρεσεν ἡ πρόκλησις τῷ βήμειᾳ' (pleased Hermias, who called Cretinas the better soldier)
'I love my friends, but I love my fatherland even more' then skips the 'I hate this man ... πατρίδα ἐμὴν μᾶλλον φιλῶ' counterpart
'I love my friends' for 'φιλῷ τέκν’' (children)
'a lawsuit regarding stolen goods' for 'δίκην ἔχοντι περὶ τῶν ἀρπαλέων' (the Harpalus money)
'he said that it makes no difference to a builder' for 'οὐδὲν γὰρ ... διαφέρειν οἰκοδόμον' (he will differ in nothing from a builder)
'would put aside their enmity whenever they were sent' drops 'ἀδὶ τὸν ὅρον' (at the frontier)
